body.statement: A solution of \(\mathrm{oeq:coupled-measurable-attainment}\), combined with \(\widetilde\theta_n\), yields \(\mathcal A^*\in\mathfrak A_{\mathrm{det}}\) whose empirical selected ambient box at depth \(k+1\) is the lexicographically first eligible closed child of its unique depth-\(k\) selected ambient box under the fixed arm-within-stratum coordinate order, with shared-boundary children tested separately and no unrelated cell eligible. Every fixed empirical prefix stabilizes to \(\mathcal D_k^\dagger\), its feasible cells stabilize to the nested population cells \(\mathcal C_k^\dagger\), and \(\widehat r_n\to r^\dagger\) locally uniformly in probability, where \(\{r^\dagger\}=\bigcap_{k=0}^{\infty}\mathcal C_k^\dagger\). Moreover, \(\sqrt n\{\widetilde\theta_n-\theta_p(q_n(h,v))\}\Rightarrow N(0,\Sigma(r^\dagger))\) uniformly over every fixed bounded nuisance fiber, and \(\mathcal R_+(\mathcal A^*)\le V^*\). Hence the lower and upper deterministic-limit local minimax envelopes both equal \(V^*\).
body.justification: The upper theorem matches the full-nuisance converse with an implementable pilot, joint estimator, and terminal rule.
body.gap: Nwankwo et al. attain scalar ATE variance and Cook et al. prove scalar adaptive AIPW limits; neither couples a set-valued regret design to a multivariate discontinuous minimax rule.
body.consumer: Independent validation of a frozen clinical-policy menu can target scarce follow-up toward the cells that minimize eventual welfare loss.
